Commentary.Commentary: Right then. We have been treated to a roller-coaster of a game between these two giants and it is the hosts who take the 1-0 lead in the series. But not a lot of time to celebrate as the second game is less than 24 hours away and Australia will have a chance to level the series soon enough. The second T20I will be played on Sunday, 11th July 2021 at 1930 local (2330 GMT). Do join us for that. Until then, cheers and take care!

The skipper of West Indies, Nicholas Pooran says he is delighted to start his captaincy with a victory. He only expected the players to show energy, which they did. Also adds, he can't praise his bowlers enough, they were just brilliant tonight. Ends by saying his side is over the last series, as they look to change their path now.

Aaron Finch, the Australian skipper says that the bowlers did a fantastic job to restrict them to a lower score. Also says he is really disappointed as they were not able to chase the game down. Says Marsh and Wade put them in control of the game, but they were unable to end it with a victory. Ends by saying they will look to come back stronger in the next game.

OBED McCOY IS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that it feels great and he has been working hard and looks at his execution very closely. Feels that the surface had some nice bounce and carry and he noticed that the spinners were getting some turn and so his slower balls would get something off the surface. Feels that they had the bowling to defend this and they defended this well.

Take a bow, West Indies! This has been a supreme bowling performance to defend such a total. It looked like they would not be able to put in a strong display, but they have proved that they have what it takes to bowl well in tough situations. Obed McCoy was the hero and the star as he ended up taking 4 to his name and completely rattled the visitors. Even Hayden Walsh took timely wickets and bowled smartly, to finish with 3 to his name. Fabian Allen got two as well, but overall, all of their bowlers were up to the task.

The Aussies started off poorly, as they lost Finch very early on. Wade then decided to charge and make full use of the Powerplay as he kept the runs coming but he too, could not last too long. After Philippe departed, the duo of Marsh and Henriques decided to swing and scored a few boundaries quickly, putting the pressure back on the hosts. But once Moises fell, the train slightly derailed. Marsh got to his fifty, but he could not last longer and take his side home and from a position of strength at 89/3, they slumped and bowed out for 127.

Wow, wow, wow! What a start we have to this series! It looked like Australia would start their Caribbean tour with a win to their name, but the hosts have put in a supreme bowling display to defend a below-par total, to take a 1-0 lead in this 5-game T20I series.

OUT! CAUGHT! Obed McCoy, TAKE A BOW! What a spell he has had with the ball today. He gets his fourth and the final wicket of the game. Serves it a touch short, outside off. Josh Hazlewood looks to poke at it. The ball though takes the outside edge and flies to the left of Nicholas Pooran, who collects the ball with ease and starts the celebrations for the West Indies side. They take an important 1-0 lead in the series. WEST INDIES WIN BY 18 RUNS!
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, on the pads. Zampa nudges it to square leg for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a game we are having. A great start to the series. West Indies are running riot at the moment. Obed McCoy gets his third of the day. He has been the game-changer for the Men in Maroon. Serves a slower ball again. On a length, on off. Starc looks to get under it and decides to go big. The ball though does not get the distance that was needed on it, as it goes towards deep mid-wicket. Fabian Allen coves a lot of ground to his left, as he is coming in from the mid-wicket region. He takes a superb running catch. The West Indies only need one more wicket to end things for the Aussies!
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: Josh Hazlewood is the last man in.
On a length, outside off, moving away. Starc swings his blade to push it out but misses. The bounce takes the ball over the blade.
Looks like Obed McCoy has mastered the slower delivery. A slower one again. Full and on off. Mitchell Starc was looking to go big but the pace gets him yet again, as he defends it out.
Slower delivery yet again. Full and outside off. Mitchell Starc looks to chase it but misses.
Tossed up, on off. Zampa defends it solidly. 20 needed in 30 balls!
Looped up on off, Starc plays the square cut and gets a single.
On off, Starc works it to the leg side.

OUT! CAUGHT! Maybe, just maybe we are witnessing a tilt here. The Australians had a firm grip on the match, but now it looks like they are in trouble. Hayden Walsh gets his third wicket. Loopy ball, on off. Dan Christian uses his feet and lifts it towards the long on region. Loud shouts for the catch and Dwayne Bravo comes chasing in and takes a sharp catch in the deep.
Commentary.Howout: c Dwayne Bravo b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Adam Zampa comes out at Number 10!
Floated on off, Dan Christian goes back and pushes it to cover.
WIDE! Tossed up down the leg side. Dan Christian looks to pull it but misses. Wide called.
On off, Starc works it to mid on for a single.
A length ball, on off. Starc flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Obed McCoy gets his second and he displays his reflexes for everybody to see. The slower delivery does the trick for the big man. Keeps it full and on leg. Agar looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge and the ball goes back towards the bowler really slowly. Obed McCoy does a forward roll as the momentum of the catch makes him do it and pouches this. Brilliant from the big man.
Mitchell Starc comes out!
Back of a length ball, outside off. Agar pulls it towards Chris Gayle at mid-wicket.
Slower ball again. Full and on off. Agar defends it out solidly.
A length ball, on off. Dan Christian pushes it to mid off for a single.
Full and outside off. it's a slower one. Dan Christian moves across and lifts it towards the mid-wicket region. The ball lands in a vacant area. The batters take a couple.
Around off, pushed through covers for one. A successful over for Hayden, 4 runs and wicket off this. 27 needed in 42 balls.
Tossed up, around off, worked through mid off for one.
Outside off, shortish, punched to short cover.
Who will come out next? It is Ashton Agar who makes his way out.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Soft dismissal and Walsh gets the big wicket of Marsh. Tried to go hard at this but with his bat face turning, it turned out to be an easy return catch for Walsh. Tossed up, around off, Mitchell Marsh looks to hit this one hard, but only manages to chip it to the right of Hayden Walsh, who moves that side and takes the return catch. 29 needed in 45 balls.
Another full toss on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Full toss on middle, worked through mid on for one.
A full toss outside off, drilled to sweeper covers and a fumble in the deep, lets them come back for the second.
Outside off, a swing and a miss!
Around middle, DC looks to work this to the leg side but the ball takes the pad and goes to the left of the keeper, who does well, to move that side and stop the ball.

Fifty for Mitchell Marsh! His first T20I half-century and he will be happy with what he has done today. But he knows that he still has to take Australia past the finish line. Around off, pushed through covers for one.
A slower length ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
A slower ball, outside off, Dan looks to sweep this one to the leg side but the ball takes the bat, then the pad and goes to the off side. They take a run.
Obed McCoy comes into the attack now. He gave away 16 runs in his first over but also picked up a wicket. He replaces Fabian Allen.
Full toss outside off, bunted to long off for a single. 35 needed from 54 balls.
Googly around off, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shortish and outside off, spinning away, hit through covers for one.
Dan Christian makes his way out at number 7.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Walsh gets the wicket and half the Australian side is back into the shed. It is a timely wicket and Ben goes back for just 2. Hayden Walsh bowls a flatter googly around middle, Ben McDermott goes back and looks to slash this one away to the off side but misses. The ball goes through and clips the middle stump. 38 needed in 57 balls.
Around off, chipped towards long on, but before the man there, for a single.
Darted on the pads, this is nudged through mid-wicket and they come back for the second.
Loopy ball, on off. Ben McDermott stays back and defends it out.
Tossed up, on off. Marsh pushes it to long off for a single.
FOUR! He is on a roll here. Flatter and outside off. Marsh waits and cuts it past the diving point fielder. The ball goes towards the boundary.
Loopy ball, on off. Marsh looks to cut it away but gets an under edge and the ball ends up in front of the keeper.
Tossed up on off, Ben McDermott pushes it to cover. A misfield gives them an opportunity to take a single.
Floated on off, Marsh goes back and pushes it through cover for a single.
On a length, on off. Marsh pushes it to long on and gets a single.
WIDE! A length ball, wide outside off. Marsh leaves it alone. Wide called.

FOUR! THUMPED! A length ball, outside off, moving away. Marsh stays back and cuts it through the cover region. Shimron Hetmyer covers a lot of ground to his right but is unable to stop the ball in the deep. The ball ends up in the boundary.
Back of a length ball, on off. Ben McDermott hops and hooks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A full length ball, on off, Ben McDermott defends it to the off side.
A length ball, on the pads. Marsh tucks it to square leg for a single.
WIDE! A length ball, down the leg side. Marsh looks to flick it but misses. A half appeal made by Nicholas Pooran behind the stumps as he collects the ball moving to his left, but it is turned down.
A length ball, on off. Marsh pushes it to cover.
On off, Ben McDermott pushes it to cover.
Dwayne Bravo comes back on. 1-0-7-0 so far.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fabian Allen gets his second and Moises Henriques goes back after a cameo. He was looking good in the middle, his intent was to chase every ball, which did not end up in his favour! Looped up, outside off. Moises Henriques looks to push it to the off side but only manages to get an outside edge. The ball flies towards Dwayne Bravo at point, who takes the simplest of catches. Four down now the Australians.
Commentary.Howout: c Dwayne Bravo b Fabian Allen

Commentary.Commentary: Ben McDermott is the new man in.
Full and on off, Mitchell Marsh works it to long on for a single. Good running by both the batters.
Flatter and on off. Moises Henriques pulls it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Tossed up and outside off, Marsh cuts it through point for a single.

SIX! Mitchell Marsh is not holding back and he has made his intentions clear. Floated on off, Marsh stays back and pulls it over the square leg fence for a maximum. The ball ends up in the stands, which means we lose another ball.
On off, pushed to covers for a single.
SIX! DISPATCHED! Full and on off. Mitchell Marsh gets low and powers it over the long off fence for a maximum. Moves to 24.
Tossed up, on off Moises Henriques goes back and pushes it to long on for a single.
On off, Moises Henriques keeps it out solidly.
Flatter and on off. Marsh hangs back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Looped up, on off. Henriques pushes it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Full and on off. Mitchell Marsh prods and drives it through the cover region for a boundary. Australia finish the Powerplay at 70/3!
A full length ball, outside off. Marsh looks to chase it but misses.
A length ball, on off, pushed to covers for a single.
SIX! HUGE! Two in a row. Obed McCoy gets punished twice after picking a wicket. Again keeps it short, on off. Moises Henriques pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for another biggie.
SIX! POWERFUL! A touch short, on off. Moises Henriques pulls it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Out comes Moises Henriques!

OUT! CAUGHT! Obed McCoy strikes on his first delivery. Josh Philippe heads back to the shed for just a run. Great stuff from the speedster. Serves a length ball, on off. Josh Philippe chips it towards Dwayne Bravo, who is stationed at mid on, who takes an easy catch to get rid of the batsman. This is not looking good for Australia.
Commentary.Howout: c Dwayne Bravo b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: Change. Time for Obed McCoy to have a go.
7 off the over! Length around off, pushed through mid on for a single.
Length around off, worked to mid on.
A slower full toss outside off, Josh Philippe does not pick it up as he looks to work it to the leg side but misses.
On a fuller length, on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
WIDE. A short ball, around off, Marsh sways away and it is wided.
FOUR! 50 up for Australia and Marsh does not miss out on this delivery. Outside off, length ball, Mitchell Marsh frees his arms and spanks this one to the deep point fence, for a boundary.
Around off, tapped to point.
Dwayne Bravo comes into the attack now. He replaces the speedster Fidel Edwards.
Josh Philippe walks in at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wade was looking very good but he gifts his wicket away here. The ball was a smart one, keeping in mind that the only fielder in the deep, in the off side, was Hetmyer at deep point. Short and wide outside off, enticing Matthew Wade to go for the big shot. He obliges and punches this one aerially towards deep point and Shimron Hetmyer has an easy take in the deep. 100 needed in 96 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Shimron Hetmyer b Andre Russell

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around off, guided to third man, for one.
Good length around off, punched to deep point for one.
SIX! Second six of the over. Taking advantage of the Powerplay, is Wade! Another short ball, again on the bodyline, not too short though. Matthew Wade swivels and deposits the ball over fine leg now.
Shortish and around leg, Wade ducks under this one.

SIX! Goes all the way there! Was hit against the wind, but still had enough power to go all the way! A short ball, on the bodyline, Matthew Wade hooks this one over the deep square leg fence for a maximum.
Andre Russell comes into the attack now. He replaces Fabian Allen.
So, 16 off the over! A good one for the Aussies! Around off, back of a length, tapped to point for one.
A low full toss on middle, this is clipped towards the deep mid-wicket region. Shimron Hetmyer fumbles in the deep and the batters take two comfortably.

SIX! BOOM! That is out of the park. Connected so well with his shot, did Wade. A smile on his face too. Not too many times that you see a batter smack a six out of the park in West Indies, and the batsman concerned was not West Indian. Around off, on a good length, Matthew Wade stands tall and smokes this one all the way over deep mid-wicket.
A slower length ball, outside off, Wade leaves it be.
WIDE. A short ball, outside off, Wade sways away and lets it pass. Wided.
Good running by the batters here. Around off, fuller, drilled to the extra cover region, where the man dives to his left and half-stops it, but the batters run hard and come back for the second.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Wade gets a streaky boundary now. A short ball, around off and middle, Matthew Wade looks to pull but the ball takes the glove and goes over the keeper, and into the ropes.
FOUR! Good end to the over for Australia as Marsh gets a boundary. On a shortish length, outside off, slashed away through point. 8 runs and a wicket for Allen to begin his spell!
Tossed up, around off, Wade pushes this to the cover region, where the man half-stops this, but the batters take the run on offer.
On off, pushed through mid on for one.

Good fielding by the West Indian players! Floated, outside off, Marsh drives this one through cover-point. Two men chase after this and one of them puts in a dive and pulls the ball back, before the ropes. Two runs.
On off, pushed to the mid off region.
Mitchell Marsh walks in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Allen strikes in his very first ball and the Australian skipper goes back for a low score. A good catch too, at the edge of the inner circle and Allen brings out his unique celebration. Tossed up, around off, Aaron Finch slams this one to the cover region. Evin Lewis is the man there, who takes this one nicely. First one down for the Aussies!
Commentary.Howout: c Evin Lewis b Fabian Allen

Commentary.Commentary: Who will bowl from the other end? It is going to be Fabian Allen. Early spin for the hosts.
On off, nudged to mid-wicket for one. 8 off the opening over!
A short ball, around off and middle, Aaron Finch gets slightly low and lets it go.
A full toss, around middle and leg, Aaron Finch swivels quick and works this to the right of fine leg, as the batters come back for the second.
Slightly behind the good length, around off, Wade goes back and cuts this one towards third man, for one.
The Australian skipper is off the mark! Around off, on a length, pushed to the left of mid off for a single.
Australia and Matthew Wade are underway on ball one! On a good length, around middle and leg, this is flicked through mid-wicket and by the time the fielder can clean up, the batters take three.
